question: Calculate total weight of package shipped in each planet . show the name of each planet .
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "planets" AS SELECT "planetid" AS "planetid", "name" AS "name" FROM table_1;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "shipments" AS SELECT "shipmentid" AS "shipmentid", "planet" AS "planet" FROM table_2;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "packages" AS SELECT "shipment" AS "shipment", "weight" AS "weight" FROM table_3;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT p.name AS planet_name,
       SUM(pk.weight) AS total_weight
FROM planets p
JOIN shipments s ON s.planet = p.planetid
JOIN packages pk ON pk.shipment = s.shipmentid
GROUP BY p.name
ORDER BY p.name;
S:
# Aggregate total shipped package weight per planet name
sql = '''
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT p.name AS planet_name,
       SUM(pk.weight) AS total_weight
FROM planets p
JOIN shipments s ON s.planet = p.planetid
JOIN packages pk ON pk.shipment = s.shipmentid
GROUP BY p.name
ORDER BY p.name;
'''
